candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Italian adverbial and temporal modifiers used to indicate time, frequency, or logical progression.
These tokens represent common Italian verb roots, prefixes, and inflectional stems associated with actions, states, and transformations.
This vector represents common Italian adjectives and intensifiers expressing scale, difficulty, or importance.
This vector represents common Italian grammatical articles, prepositions, and pronouns used for spatial and relational context.
This feature activates for common Italian determiners, pronouns, and noun stems starting with the letters "qu" or "ust".
This feature vector represents anatomical limbs and body parts, particularly focusing on arms and legs.
This feature vector activates on prefixes and sub-word units of English words related to obstacles, difficulties, and attributes (such as handicap, predispose, and impede).
This vector represents occupational or skill-based distinctions, contrasting professional and commercial endeavors with amateur, personal, or standard ones.
This vector is related to various sports and athletic activities, particularly golf.
This vector represents words denoting scale, rank, importance, or musical keys.
